content.concept_description: A player attempts to clear an intricate arrow maze level by tapping arrows in sequence, but makes repeated illegal moves losing hearts until failing.
content.why_it_works: The ad presents a highly complex, satisfying arrow labyrinth and demonstrates repeated failure, triggering viewer ego and urge to solve it correctly.

visuals.notable_objects: Hearts / life counter, Arrow puzzle maze, FAILED rubber stamp

emotions.emotional_arc: Curious engagement turning into tension and frustration as hearts deplete until total failure

end_card.cta_and_text: Arrow Puzzle, This feature is not included in the actual gameplay yet. at 00:28

gameplay.core_gameplay_notes: Tap arrows to slide them free from an intertwined maze without colliding with blocked paths; mistakes deduct hearts.

chapterization.chapter_description: Initial view of the massive intricate floral arrow maze zooming in.
Player taps arrows, hitting blocked paths and losing hearts.
Rapid succession of mistakes as hearts drop from five to zero.
All hearts break and a large red FAILED stamp slams onto the screen.
App logo with brand title and disclaimer.
